name: JS Beat Lyrics
description: JavaScript node demo: a new word on every beat drawn into a 2D canvas (setup + per-frame code, canvas(w, h) texture output), warped by a shader with liquid ripples, RGB split, glow, an outline echo and Feedback trails. Works with the metronome, mic or a music file. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Words, Look and Beat.

data.text:
# JS Beat Lyrics
A JavaScript node writes a new word on every beat into a 2D canvas; a shader warps it, splits it into RGB, makes it glow and leaves fading trails.
Works with the metronome (audio menu → Metronome), the mic or a music file. With the audio off the beat clock free-runs, so the words keep changing.
## What the JS does
- Setup (runs once): the word lists, a 1024×512 canvas(w, h) and a draw(word) function that paints each word into three channels: R = crisp fill, G = blurred glow (ctx.filter = 'blur(18px)'), B = outline.
- Every frame: word = list[floor(audio.beatCount) % length], on the stable beat clock; while it is unsure (audio.trust < 0.5: a track change) the word holds. The canvas is redrawn only when the word, list, font or size changes, so the texture is uploaded once per beat.
- Outputs: words (the canvas → sampler2D), pulse (audio.beat × Beat punch, scaled by the beat confidence) and hue (Base hue + beat × Hue step).
## Make it yours
- Double-click the JS node (in the JS Words group) and edit state.sets in the setup block to write your own lyrics. Param kinds have no text kind, so the words live in the code; the Lyrics param picks a list by index (keep its options in the same order as the list names).
- Change state.fonts for other typefaces, or draw anything else on the canvas (emoji, shapes, images).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P: Words, Look and Beat settings; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## JS Words
setup: word lists, fonts, the canvas and draw().
frame: picks the word for floor(audio.beatCount) (held while audio.trust < 0.5), redraws on change, returns { words: canvas, pulse, hue }.
Params are read by label: params['Lyrics'], params['Font'], params['Font size'], params['Beat punch'], params['Base hue'], params['Hue step'].

## Warp & Trails
Lyric Warp samples the canvas through sine ripples, punches in and splits RGB on the beat, adds an outline echo that grows over each beat (x the beat clock's trust), and keeps max(new, last frame × Trails) from the Feedback buffer (rgba16f) for glowing trails.

## Stage & Grade
Lyric Stage adds a violet backdrop, a beat-swelling spotlight in the word colour, light rays and a wet-floor reflection (both read the trail Feedback) and fine scanlines; then ACES tonemap, vignette and grain.

data.label: Lyrics
data.description: Which word list the JS node cycles through (edit the lists in the JS setup code).

data.label: Font size
data.description: Text size in canvas pixels (1024×512 canvas); long words shrink to fit.

data.label: Warp
data.description: Strength of the liquid sine warp.

data.label: Chromatic split
data.description: RGB split of the letters (wider on the beat).

data.label: Trails
data.description: How much of the last frame stays: 0 = none, 0.97 = long smears.

data.label: Light rays
data.description: Radial light rays streaming from the words.

data.label: Floor reflection
data.description: Mirror image of the words on a wet floor.

data.label: Base hue
data.description: Hue of the first word (read by the JS node).

data.label: Hue step
data.description: Hue change per beat (read by the JS node).

data.label: Beat punch
data.description: Zoom, split and glow kick on each beat (read by the JS node; full once the beat is locked, 35% while it free-runs).
